device_entry.name: LCC25液晶控制器
tags: 电子器件供电与台架测试
device_entry.description: Thorlabs LCC25 是一款用于驱动液晶模块的电子控制器，可设置两个输出电压，并按设定重复频率在两者之间切换；还可配置驻留时间、扫描增量和设置存储。它常用于实验室中对液晶器件进行稳定的电压驱动与动态切换控制。
device_entry.description_en: The Thorlabs LCC25 is an electronic controller for liquid crystal modules. It can set two output voltages and alternate between them at a defined repetition rate, with related settings such as dwell time, sweep increment, and stored configurations. It is used in laboratories to drive and switch liquid crystal devices under controlled electrical conditions.
